query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as "count!"
                FROM friend_relation fr
                JOIN users u ON fr.friend_id = u.id
                WHERE fr.user_id = $1 AND fr.status = 1
                AND (
                    u.username ILIKE $2 OR 
                    u.nickname ILIKE $2 OR 
                    fr.remark ILIKE $2
                )
